description.value: The Pitt Meadows Museum occupies two heritage sites facing each other on Harris Road beside the CP Rail tracks: the 1908 General Store (the oldest known structure in Pitt Meadows, with parts dating to 1886) and the Hoffmann and Son Machine Shop, which displays over 60 restored stationary gasoline engines and a working forge. The General Store houses permanent and temporary exhibits on early settlement history alongside a community archives and reference library. Admission is by donation.

address.value: 12294 Harris Rd, Pitt Meadows BC V3Y 2E9

concerns: OSM record has no address field; address sourced entirely from website contact page.
OSM name 'Pitt Meadows Museum General Store' refers only to the General Store site, but the website and phone number represent the whole museum (both General Store and Hoffmann sites).
No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) could be confirmed from the website; an on-site verification call would clarify.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-documented heritage attraction with two distinct sites on Harris Road; a genuine cultural stop for touring cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley. Admission by donation lowers the barrier for drop-in visits.
